description:
Hushfacebook 0.1.1 is 0.1.0 with its settings screen fixed. Same 13 patches, same targets: Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 (the current release) and 577.0.0.50.72, arm64-v8a.

## Fixed

- The Hushfacebook settings screen is readable. On 0.1.0 every row title was drawn in Facebook's near-black text on the black page, and the Export diagnostic report and Clear diagnostic data rows showed up blank. Both turned up on a Galaxy S25 running 0.1.0, and a test now fails if any row is untitled or drawn dark.

## Installing

Add the source in Morphe Manager 1.31.0 or newer with the link in the README, then patch the arm64-v8a Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 bundle from APKMirror. The .mpp here is the patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. SHA256SUMS.txt has its checksum, and the release receipt records what it was checked against.

## What was checked

All 13 patches applied to the real 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 bundles with no manifest changes. 73 extension tests and all 73 patch tests passed, along with both Android lint checks. On an Android 16 emulator the settings screen opened from the launcher shortcut with every row readable, including over Facebook's signed-out screens.
